job.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java)
job.description:
About the Role
Our client is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer (Java) to design, develop and maintain scalable, high-performance backend systems and services. 

The role will focus on Java backend development, microservices architecture, system performance and reliability, and the delivery of system enhancements. The successful candidate will also provide technical guidance to the development team and collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Lead technical design for new features, system enhancements and architecture improvements.
  • Develop and maintain microservices applications using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
  • Design and optimise APIs, databases, caches and message-queue components.
  • Monitor and optimise backend performance, including response time, throughput, database efficiency, caching and system resource utilisation.
  • Design and support high-concurrency, high-availability and distributed systems.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents and implement appropriate monitoring, security, protection and recovery measures.
  • Conduct code reviews, guide backend developers and maintain technical documentation and coding standards.
  • Work with product, development, QA and operations teams to support deployments, ongoing operations and project delivery. 

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of Java backend development experience, with at least 2 years in a team-lead or backend technical-lead capacity.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud and MyBatis; experience with Dubbo or other microservices frameworks.
  • Experience with MySQL, Redis and message queues such as RocketMQ, RabbitMQ or Kafka, including SQL optimisation and cache design.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting large-scale, high-concurrency backend systems with strong performance, availability and reliability requirements.
  • Good knowledge of distributed transactions, distributed locks and high-concurrency system design.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as ELK or SkyWalking.
  • Exposure to payment/order systems, A/B testing, recommendation systems, Elasticsearch, Flink or StarRocks would be an advantage.
  • Good analytical, problem-solving and collaboration skills, with good written and spoken Chinese, including Mandarin, and working proficiency in English.

job.title: Game Systems Designer
job.description:
About the Role
Our client is seeking a Game Systems Designer to design and develop game features and systems from concept through implementation and post-release optimisation.

The role will focus on systems design, game economy and numerical design, gameplay mechanics, configuration and data-driven optimisation. The successful candidate will work closely with development, art and QA teams to deliver and continuously improve game features.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design game features and systems, including rules, user flows, interface behaviour and interaction logic.
  • Prepare clear systems-design documents, functional requirements and configuration specifications.
  • Develop reusable game systems and features that can support different gameplay requirements.
  • Define system behaviour for different user scenarios, exceptions and interruption or recovery flows.
  • Prepare and maintain configuration tables and test data in collaboration with development teams.
  • Design and optimise game economy, progression, reward and resource systems, including numerical frameworks and balancing parameters.
  • Analyse player behaviour and live product data to identify optimisation opportunities, and use A/B testing to evaluate gameplay and numerical changes.
  • Use player segmentation and behavioural insights to support differentiated progression, reward and numerical strategies.
  • Conduct competitor and market analysis and translate findings into practical design improvements.
  • Work closely with development, art, QA and operations teams throughout development, testing and release. 

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Digital Media Technology, Computer Science, Interactive Media or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in game systems design, gameplay design or a related role.
  • Experience in game systems and numerical or game economy design, including progression, rewards and balancing.
  • Experience translating design concepts into system rules, user flows, functional requirements and configuration specifications.
  • Experience using player or product data and A/B testing to support system and numerical optimisation.
  • Ability to work closely with developers on system logic and technical implementation, and collaborate effectively with art and QA teams.
  • Good analytical, documentation and communication skills, with good written and spoken Chinese, including Mandarin, and working proficiency in English.
  • Experience with casual, social, mobile or mini-games, player segmentation or related game-development tools would be an advantage. 

Application Process

job.title: Game Economy & Systems Designer - Casual Games
job.description:
About the Role
Our client is seeking a Game Economy & Systems Designer to own the numbers behind casual games, including currencies, rewards, progression, level difficulty and monetisation. The role will build balancing models, turn them into configuration tables, work with developers to put them into the game, and use live data to adjust them after release. 

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and balance in-game currencies, resources, rewards, item values and upgrade costs.
  • Design ad-reward placements and values, such as rewarded videos for extra lives, boosters or currency, and balance them against in-app purchases so that both fit the player progression and neither undermines the other.
  • Build progression and difficulty curves that give players clear goals and a steady pace of challenge and reward.
  • Build and maintain balancing models and simulations in Excel, VBA and Python to test changes before release.
  • Define reward formulas and drop or probability tables, and check the results with developers and quality assurance after implementation.
  • Design event rewards and pricing for limited-time offers that fit the core economy.
  • Write numerical design documents and configuration tables, and keep table structures, naming and validation rules consistent across versions.
  • Track retention, conversion, lifetime value, average revenue per user and return on investment after each release; identify bottlenecks and propose improvements.
  • Support the testing and review of balancing changes and report on the results.
  • Work closely with product, development, quality assurance and operations teams.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in game economy, numerical or systems design, including game balancing and progression design.
  • Strong Excel skills, with hands-on experience using VBA or Python for modelling, simulation or data analysis.
  • Experience analysing game data and using insights to improve game balance and player experience.
  • Ability to prepare clear numerical documentation and work effectively with developers and non-technical teams.
  • Good command of written and spoken English. Proficiency in written Simplified Chinese and spoken Mandarin will be an advantage.
  • Experience with casual/mobile games, international markets, live operations, ad monetisation or probability-based reward systems would be an advantage.

Application Process
To apply, please click "Apply Now" and submit your application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team regarding the next steps of the selection process.
